About this item

  • WAKE UP TO FRESH COFFEE: Program your brew up to 24 hours ahead so it's ready when you are. Designed for busy mornings and effortless routines, this coffee maker puts convenience on your countertop.
  • 0
  • CLEAR, SIMPLE DISPLAY: The easy-to-read digital screen makes it effortless to program your brew, check the time, or make adjustments—even on your sleepiest mornings.
  • POUR MID-BREW WITH EASE: The pause and serve feature lets you grab a cup while coffee's still brewing—no mess, no wait. Perfect for busy mornings when every second counts.
  • SUSTAINABLE & SIMPLE: Comes with a reusable filter basket and measuring scoop, so you can skip the paper waste and enjoy a hassle-free brew every time.

Product Description

With a programmable timer that lets you set your brew up to 24 hours in advance, you can wake up to fresh coffee every morning. Choose between regular or bold strength for your ideal brew, and enjoy consistent flavor from the first cup to the last with the carafe’s mixing tube. The easy-to-read LCD display and user-friendly features make brewing simple, while the automatic shut-off and cleaning cycle ensure hassle-free operation. Whether you need a quick pour or a hot cup waiting for you, this coffee maker has it all.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find the coffee maker easy to use and appreciate its several color options. The coffee quality receives positive feedback, with one customer noting it brews a perfect pot every time. However, the durability is concerning, with multiple reports of the glass carafe breaking during washing and the heating element failing within months. Moreover, the reliability and value for money are mixed, with some reporting it stops working after two weeks while others say it's worth the cost.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Aesthetic/Affordable 12-cup coffee pot
We're simple people when it comes to coffee. We drink a lot. Love the 12 cup size. Love the permanent built-in filter (pictured) that makes it so you honestly don't have to use disposable ones! Money saver! It has a timer so you can set and forget the night before. Keeps warm a few hours. Pours smooth. Also it's so beautiful. Love the cream color if you're an aesthetic beige kitchen appliance girly and it's at a price point that's WAY lower and more affordable than a lot of other aesthetic coffee makers! Very pleased with this one.

    I was so excited to find a coffee pot that is the exact same shade of purple that’s my favorite color. I was pleasantly surprised to find a reusable coffee filter that came with the machine. The setup took less than 5 minutes from the start of opening the box all the way to programming the time for my coffee to brew the next morning. The coffee was already freshly brewed when I woke up for the day which 10000/10 was so excited about. The quality of this is way better than I imagined given some of the reviews I saw. The coffee itself dripped nicely, no mess or anything. The plate stayed hot for 2 hours. One feature I loved about this, is that it shows you how long the pot has been sitting since brewed. After 2 hours when the pot turns off it reverts back to the regular time. It’s nice to be able to see how long the pot had been sitting prior to serving myself.

    The counter space taken up is extremely minimal, this is a great coffee maker.

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    Only complaint is that you have to lift up the top to put in the coffee grinds. We want to see a coffee pot in which you add water to the side as well as being able to pull out the coffee grounds to the side. This way you don’t have to pull up the top of the coffee pot and constantly pull it out from underneath the hanging counters. But this bella coffee pot delivers hot, great tasting coffee. It has its own basket, which is wonderful if you filter collapses. And if you don’t have a paper filter than your perfectly fine using the coffee basket. No strong taste or smell of plastic. It’s nice that the coffee pot weighs enough to be able to push the buttons on the front and not have it slide backwards. Don’t have to wonder if the coffee pot is left on because the buttons are right there in front.

    It pours very well. It also has a tube that the coffee drips down into which helps keep it hot. Our bunn, has Bunn been relegated to the downstairs guest kitchen because it doesn’t deliver as hot as coffee as the Bella it’s because the coffee drips down through the air long before it reaches the pot. This one doesn’t do that and it’s been the best so far. Let’s hope it lasts a long time. Because the other ones we are throwing away about once a year and we’re beginning to think manufacturing has to be better regulated to protect the customer and the Earth from all the extra waste. .

Because the other ones we are throwing away about once a year and we’re beginning to think manufacturing has to be better regulated to protect the customer and the Earth from all the extra waste. .

About this Item

  • WAKE UP TO FRESH COFFEE: Program your brew up to 24 hours ahead so it's ready when you are. Designed for busy mornings and effortless routines, this coffee maker puts convenience on your countertop.
  • 0
  • CLEAR, SIMPLE DISPLAY: The easy-to-read digital screen makes it effortless to program your brew, check the time, or make adjustments—even on your sleepiest mornings.
  • POUR MID-BREW WITH EASE: The pause and serve feature lets you grab a cup while coffee's still brewing—no mess, no wait. Perfect for busy mornings when every second counts.
  • SUSTAINABLE & SIMPLE: Comes with a reusable filter basket and measuring scoop, so you can skip the paper waste and enjoy a hassle-free brew every time.

Product Description

With a programmable timer that lets you set your brew up to 24 hours in advance, you can wake up to fresh coffee every morning. Choose between regular or bold strength for your ideal brew, and enjoy consistent flavor from the first cup to the last with the carafe’s mixing tube. The easy-to-read LCD display and user-friendly features make brewing simple, while the automatic shut-off and cleaning cycle ensure hassle-free operation. Whether you need a quick pour or a hot cup waiting for you, this coffee maker has it all.
